headline: EPS surges on both comparisons
summary_short: GAIL (India) reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₹7.10, up 214.2% q/q and 97.2% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ₹7.10 more than tripled sequentially from ₹2.26 (+214.2%) and nearly doubled year-over-year from ₹3.60 (+97.2%). This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
